\begin{document}
A spinor changes sign under a full rotation,
\begin{equation}
\cos\frac{\theta}{2} = -1 \text{ and } \theta \equiv 2\pi .
\label{eq:full}
\end{equation}
For small $\theta$ the overlap of the rotated and unrotated states is
\begin{equation}
\cos\frac{\theta}{2} = 1 - \frac{\theta^2}{8} + O(\theta^4) .
\label{eq:small}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
